news.title: Future Eagles Come From Behind to Beat Cyprus at FIFA U-15 World Cup
news.lede: Nigeria’s Future Eagles recorded their first victory at the 2026 FIFA U-15 World Cup and Festival in Baku, Azerbaijan, after coming from behind to defeat Cyprus 2-1. The Nigerian youngsters showed resilience and determination to overturn an early deficit, with goals from Wisdom Oche and Timothy Ijach securing a memorable victory for the team. Cyprus took the lead in the 12th minute through Georgios Christodoulou, putting the Future Eagles under pressure early in the encounter. However, Nigeria responded swiftly, as Wisdom Oche restored parity in the 17th minute to bring the West African side back into the contest.

news.title: Celebrating football’s social impact across Europe - the 2027 UEFA #FootbALL Awards
news.lede: Applications are now open for the UEFA #FootbALL Awards, once again recognising projects and individuals across European football for their extraordinary work in social sustainability. The third edition of the UEFA #FootbALL Awards will continue to highlight and recognise the work of national associations, clubs, leagues and players in the field of social sustainability. First launched in 2023 and celebrated at the biennial UEFA Respect Forum, the #FootbALL Awards praise outstanding efforts to promote diversity, inclusion and accessibility across European football - values that lie at the heart of our #FootbALL programme. The last edition of the awards highlighted projects and individuals making a tangible difference through initiatives focused on inclusivity, anti-discrimination and community engagement.

news.title: Ballon d'Or: Will Lamine Yamal, Harry Kane, Kylian Mbappe or Lionel Messi win?
news.lede: Who should win the men's Ballon d'Or? The Ballon d'Or winner will be announced in London on 26 October - but who is going to win it? Bookmakers have Spain winger Lamine Yamal and England captain Harry Kane very close together as clear favourites. Lamine Yamal won La Liga with Barcelona and the World Cup with Spain, while Kane scored 73 goals for German champions Bayern Munich and England.
